source_inference_limits: Wii retains separate winding/texture and UV dispatches. This motivates the Windows rewrite; Windows full-body compilation decides exactness.
Windows retains checkerboard tests with equal texture arguments. Wii omits those tests; their even-first order is recovered from Windows instructions.
Moving the face header store outside the winding branches regresses Windows. The accepted source retains the Windows store ownership.
Other path builders remain partial; no exactness or byte credit transfers from S-bend.
